summary: Deprecated access to the parent component's instance state. Use Parent Component Object (net.noodl.ParentComponentObject).
description: The legacy Parent Component State node read and wrote the enclosing parent component's instance-scoped state — the role now filled by Parent Component Object and Set Parent Component Object Properties. Deprecated and hidden from the picker.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use net.noodl.ParentComponentObject (with Set Parent Component Object Properties) instead.
runtimeBehavior: Property ports are generated from the per-instance `properties` list (runtime-discovered).
